title: T.B. Scott Free Library to explore ghost hunting
excerpt: MERRILL — Get ready to delve into the unexplained when the T.B. Scott Free Library hosts founding members of Paranormal of Wisconsin for an afternoon
content:
MERRILL — Get ready to delve into the unexplained when the T.B. Scott Free Library hosts founding members of Paranormal of Wisconsin for an afternoon exploring the world of paranormal investigation.

The program, featuring Jason Bertram and Michelle Bertram, will take place from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Oct. 17 at the T.B. Scott Free Library, 106 W. First St., Merrill.

Attendees will have the opportunity to view paranormal evidence, learn about the equipment used during investigations, hear firsthand accounts of the Bertrams’ experiences, and ask questions about the world of ghost hunting.

Since founding Paranormal of Wisconsin in 2009, the Bertrams have traveled throughout the Midwest investigating reports of paranormal activity in businesses, private residences and other locations.

Whether you’re a longtime believer, a curious skeptic, or simply fascinated by the unexplained, this program offers a unique opportunity to learn more about paranormal investigations from two experienced investigators.

For more information, contact the T.B. Scott Free Library at 715-536-7191 or visit the library’s website.
